annotations.title: Send the user's signup to Aldro

description: Call this only after the user has explicitly said yes, in this chat, to sending their name, email and business details to Aldro to get their business taxes or bookkeeping done. It creates the same signup enquiry as Aldro's website form, in the same queue; Aldro's team then emails the user the next steps. Set consent to true only when the user agreed. Testing the tool? Set test to true. It is not a marketing opt-in and takes no payment. Limits: 5 signups an hour per connection, 25 a day in total.

consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed in this chat to share these details with Aldro.

country.description: US for the United States, CA for Canada.

email.description: The email address Aldro should reply to.

entity.description: Business type. US: sole_prop, single_member_llc, multi_member_llc, partnership, s_corp, c_corp. Canada: sole_prop or corporation.

message.description: Optional. Anything the user wants Aldro to know.

service.description: tax (yearly business tax filing), bookkeeping (monthly), both, or catch-up (behind on the books).

test.description: Optional. true when you are testing this tool rather than sending a real user's signup. The enquiry is stored, marked as a test, and nobody emails it.

name: start_onboarding
title: Send the user's signup to Aldro
